set.body: Follow the bounded JVM host receipt docs/evidence/jvm-host-20261028/README.md. Package or otherwise expose an identifiable app for OS screenshot and actual drag-resize/scale/occlusion acceptance. Inject adapter/device request timeout and late completion, verify request/object retirement and no managed callback. Preserve separate quiet-window CPU/power and Native UI launch gates. Operable workbench/focus/editing/IME/accessibility and matched ScalaFX comparison follow the existing interactive-host plan. Do not treat renderer PNGs or partial-open fault stages as these acceptance results.
set.title: Qualify JVM host OS visuals and asynchronous request timeout paths
